audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted its own text and the packet chart: win[]/phases[].side read Graves, Skill, Galio, Galio, Graves, Galio, Galio while the whys say Graves wins Level 2, three is even, 4-5 is flat, six is Galio's, first item is even, and Graves reclaims 2+ items. Packet levelChart is Graves, Graves, Skill, Skill, Galio, Skill, Graves.
audit.why: A chart that disagrees with its own prose and with the packet is the failure mode that cost a previous run a whole champion. The prose is right; the sides were wrong.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Graves, Graves, Skill, Skill, Galio, Skill, Graves, with ratings normalised (Graves rows 7/10, Skill rows 5/10, Galio row 3/10) and the full-layer whys restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold Level 6 as a Graves spike (Collateral Damage) when Level 6 is Galio's — Hero's Entrance is the global that flips the level.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s at 4000/4750/5500 range; Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s. Six belongs to Galio because his ult creates a dive that Graves' ult cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Level-6 phase now names Hero's Entrance with its 140-180s cooldown and the W taunt it stacks with, and tells you to hold Collateral Damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places claimed Smoke Screen blinds — phases[6].why ('smoke-screen blinds') and report[10] ('Your W smoke blinds tower dives'). Riot's current text for the W is a sight-range reduction plus initial magic damage and a brief slow. No blind.
audit.why: Same hard error the mirror audit (galio vs graves) already corrected on the other side. Believing the W blinds makes players walk into Colossal Smash and Justice Punch expecting whiffs.
audit.corrected: Both lines rewritten to sight-cut plus slow. Justice Punch (E) confirmed as the 11/10/9/8/7s dash knockup that is the lane's real clock; Idol of Durand (W) 18/17/16/15/14s taunt named as the thing to bait before spending Quickdraw.

audit.why: packet flagged wants.foe[2] 'Use Hero's Entrance' as a probable wrong ability name — it is a false positive; Hero's Entrance is Galio's real R in the kit file.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Quickdraw (E) online — auto, dash for the True Grit resists, auto again. Winds of War poke can't answer point-blank shells.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Even at three: End of the Line off terrain beats Winds of War, but his bulk and zoning deny a commit.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Justice Punch; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Flat through 4-5: trade in shell rhythm, two autos and out. Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 — step in only while it is down.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Six is his: Hero's Entrance (140-180s) flies in for a full-CC dive on top of the W taunt. Hold Collateral Damage.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: First item is even — Q-AA-E-AA removes half bars, but his HP and the MR he buys soak more than most melees.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: You reclaim the duel — shells, Q and R are physical, so the MR he stacked all game is wasted. Split and force it.

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

edits.before: Galio spends Justice Punch early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Smoke cuts their sight, not your damage — fog the pick, then Collateral Damage the runner.

notes: Smoke Screen does not blind — same factual error the mirror audit corrected on Galio's side; fixed here in phases[6].why and report[10]. Level chart was internally contradictory (sides disagreed with the whys and with packet.levelChart) and has been flipped as one atomic group. packet defect 'wrong ability name' at wants.foe[2] is a false positive: Hero's Entrance is correct.
